verdict.rationale: Twenty documents no-code custom objects and custom fields [twenty-docs-1, twenty-docs-33, twenty-docs-12] and kanban boards with grouping and saved views [twenty-docs-2, twenty-docs-34]. Deals have stages [twenty-docs-14] and dashboards track pipeline metrics [twenty-docs-6]. An ops user could plausibly model separate stage-based kanban pipelines per product or motion, but this is inferred from general configuration features rather than a documented multi-pipeline capability. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of multiple pipelines on one object with distinct stage sets, per-pipeline stage configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
